connectors.name: NL Wallet verification server
connectors.description: Open-source verifier from the NL Wallet repository. A relying party runs the verification_server on its own infrastructure, starts a disclosure session from its backend, and receives the verified attributes through the requester API. The NL Wallet presents SD-JWT or ISO/IEC 18013-5:2021 mdoc over OpenID4VP. The architecture walkthrough follows OpenID4VP draft 20. The published guides are development documentation, and the source is EUPL-1.2. This is a component of the NL Wallet solution for relying parties, not a separate commercial connector product.
